watch.text: QB Tait Reynolds is out for the season and backup Christopher Vizzina (concussion) 'definitely will not be back'; third-stringer Trent Pearman starts vs South Carolina.
Swinney expects LB Jeremiah Alexander back after missing Duke and hopes WR Tyler Brown and CB Elliot Washington II return for South Carolina.
QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) missed the Arkansas loss and returned vs Georgia on Nov. 21 (87 passing yards, 1 INT in a 34-6 loss); our ratings carry the game without him.
QB Billy Edwards Jr. warmed up but didn't play at Virginia; Belichick said he was 'doing a lot better' by week's end but won't name a starter between him and Travis Burgess for NC State.
QB Julian Sayin (right elbow surgery) has missed four games since Oct. 17 (OSU 1-3) and is not expected back for Michigan; Luke Fahey starts. Ratings still carry Sayin's games.
Starter Kamario Taylor is out for the season and fill-in AJ Swann (left foot, wore a boot) missed Tennessee Tech; Lebby says the Egg Bowl QB is 'still being decided', Billy Puckett the alternative.
WR Mike Matthews (knee) is out for the season; RB DeSean Bishop (leg, left the LSU game) 'looked good' Monday but is being evaluated through the week.
Mike Norvell was fired after the Oct. 31 home loss to Clemson; interim Rick Stockstill is 2-1 and says Ashton Daniels (FBS-high 14 INTs) stays the starter.
FSU had its top four RBs out (No. 5 Zay Parks started) in the 28-10 home loss to NC State on Nov. 21; edge Rylan Kennedy and RB Amari Thomas are out for the season.
S Kobe Black (knee, hurt vs Arkansas) is out for the season per Steve Sarkisian; a top backup with 341 snaps. DT Hero Kanu (biceps surgery) could 'potentially' return for the playoffs.
QB Bryce Underwood has a lower-body injury from the Nov. 21 UCLA win; Whittingham says he starts at Ohio State barring a practice setback. RB Jordan Marshall missed UCLA, hoped back.
S Luke Talich (torn Achilles vs SMU, team leader with 3 INTs) is out for the season; LB Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa (knee) and WR Jaden Greathouse (hand) are ruled out for Syracuse.
QB Jaden Craig (ankle) was ruled out for Texas Tech on Monday's initial Big 12 availability report after missing the Utah loss; sophomore Adam Schobel makes his second start.
TCU fired Sonny Dykes on Sunday after the 38-17 home loss to Utah; defensive coordinator Andy Avalos is interim coach for Texas Tech. RB G'Ivori Graham is also out.
QB Keelon Russell (ankle) sat out the Nov. 21 Chattanooga win; DeBoer said Nov. 23 he is in a 'good spot' and expected to practice fully for Auburn. Not formally named starter.
QB Jared Curtis (hand/wrist) is 'banged up' but expected to play; OL Clinton Azubuike (carted off at Florida) and Lyndon Cooper (shoulder) are questionable, per Clark Lea.
QB Steve Angeli (AC joint, right shoulder, hurt Nov. 21 at BC) ruled out vs Notre Dame by Fran Brown on Monday; Malachi Nelson starts. Our ratings were built with Angeli.
QB Ty Dieffenbach (minor hip injury) was carted off in OT at Michigan Nov. 21; Chesney says he is not ruled out for USC but 'nowhere near in the clear'. Madden Iamaleava is next.
RB CJ Baxter (RB1 in 10 of 11 games) and RT Malachi Wood (10 straight starts) were hurt at Missouri; Will Stein calls both day to day, likely game-time decisions for Louisville.
LB Luke Mergott (leg, hurt before halftime vs Clemson) is out for the season, Manny Diaz said Monday; Will Felder takes more snaps. Diaz hopes to have Kyon Loud back.
RB Duke Scott, back from a lower-body injury, was hurt again in the 28-10 win at Florida State (7 carries, 24 yards); his status for North Carolina is unknown.
RB Kewan Lacy is out for the season (shoulder surgery); RB Shekai Mills-Knight (high ankle) is a game-time call but 'ahead of where we thought', per Golding Nov. 23.
DL Kam Franklin (hamstring) and Will Echoles, held out vs Wofford, practiced fully Monday and are expected to play; Golding takes back defensive play-calling for the Egg Bowl.
QB Mason Heintschel tore his ACL in the Oct. 2 win at Virginia Tech; Pitt is 1-5 since, and Narduzzi says Holden Geriner starts if healthy. No new update found this week.
Starting QB Tayven Jackson (upper body) is ruled out for UAB, and backup Chris Jimerson Jr. hurt his knee at Tulane on Nov. 21; Neal Brown was not optimistic about him.
Third QB Chaston Ditta is 'not going to be ready,' so slot receiver James Tyre (4-of-7 at Tulane) could start at quarterback vs UAB.
QB Alonza Barnett III missed five games (Sept. 19-Oct. 24, hamstring) and has played the last four since Oct. 30; ratings still carry the games without him.
Cignetti said C Bray Lynch (lower leg) 'doesn't look good'; WR Nick Marsh left the Washington loss, G Joe Brunner is out for the year and RB Turbo Richard (shoulder) has missed two games.
QB undecided for Purdue: Grant Wilson started the last two games while Josh Hoover (right shoulder) was hurt; Hoover relieved him at Washington, and both get first-team reps.
QB Conner Weigman (shoulder) missed the West Virginia win; Willie Fritz said he 'threw the ball some and felt a little better' Monday, decision by Thursday or Friday; else Keisean Henderson starts.
QB Kevin Jennings rolled his ankle in the 2nd quarter of the Nov. 21 loss at Notre Dame and was limited, per Lashlee; no status update found yet for Stanford.
Colton Joseph started the 42-10 win at Purdue on Nov. 21; Fickell says Joseph 'has earned the right' (no formal call yet) and Ryan Hopkins only cleared concussion protocol late last week.
C Drew Bobo (back) missed the last two games; Kirby Smart: 'We think he'll be able to play this week.' There is no SEC availability report for the nonconference Georgia Tech game.
QB Avery Johnson has been out since late October and is expected to miss the rest of the season; Dillon Duff has started for the Wildcats, so our ratings still carry his early starts.
CB Ja'Boree Antoine (out all season since fall camp) and RG Max Buchanan (knee, hurt vs Clemson Oct. 3) are back practicing; Cristobal says both may play BC.
WR Malachi Toney (high ankle sprain, surgery) has been out since a Nov. 4 practice; Cristobal put him about 1.5 weeks out, so BC looks unlikely.
QB Alessio Milivojevic (arm, hurt vs Washington) is almost certainly out at Rutgers; third-stringer Kayd Coffman started the 45-7 loss to Oregon, and Cam Fancher (leg) is 'hopeful'.
Mike Elko has not picked a QB for Texas: Marcel Reed was benched vs Tennessee and Brady Hart started the 28-7 loss at Oklahoma (8 of 20, 131 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT).
Elko ruled out sophomore DT Landon Rink (illness) for Texas; he also missed the Oklahoma game.
RB Quinten Joyner, WR Jalen Jones and S Miquel Dingle Jr. are out and OLB LaDamion Guyton doubtful on Monday's initial Big 12 availability report for TCU.
WR Coy Eakin is probable and Joey McGuire expects him back in his starting role; McGuire said WR Micah Hudson should be good and RB Cam Dickey is close to 100%.
RB Ty Clark (team-high 591 rushing yards, 11 TDs) is out for the season after being hurt in the 50-29 win at Georgia Tech, Jake Dickert said Monday; Deuce Lawrence and Jamar Searcy step in.
Starting QB Micah Alejado (left knee, carted off in the 16-8 loss at Nevada) is out for the Sacramento State finale; freshman Bjorn Jurgensen makes his first career start.
QB Michael Van Buren has been out since Oct. 31; Luke Kromenhoek has started since and USF has lost three straight.
USF parted ways with offensive coordinator Tim Beck after the Nov. 21 loss at FAU, one game before the finale.
QB Bishop Davenport returned as the starter on Nov. 7 after missing games with an injury and has started every game since; earlier games without him still weigh on our rating.
Coach Scotty Walden was fired (interim Kyle Beyer), and QB EJ Colson has been out since Nov. 12 with Raymond Moore III starting; Rotowire lists Nov. 28 as his estimated return, unconfirmed.
Army played the 10-6 loss to East Carolina on Nov. 21 without three starting offensive linemen (C Brady Small in a boot, Kyle Kloska, Henry Appleton); Paolo Gennarelli also left hurt.
Washington State (2-9) has slumped, capped by a 42-14 loss at Texas State on Nov. 21; QB Owen Eshelman played the whole game, no injury reported.
QB Pop Watson hurt his ankle early vs Toledo and missed the Nov. 18 Akron game (Logan Inagawa started); no update yet for Bowling Green.
Starting QB Angel Flores is out for the season after ankle surgery; Jadyn Glasser starts.
Starting QB Cameran Brown is out again for the Nov. 28 Louisiana game (his fourth straight missed game, per 247Sports via Rotowire); Ayden Pereira starts.
Starting QB Noah Kim has missed the last three games (EMU 0-3) with an undisclosed injury; Brogan McCaughey is expected to start vs Kent State.
True freshman Drew Bellisari, the fourth-string QB, starts again (2-0 so far); Caleb Heavner was hurt vs Ohio on 11/11 and Gotkowski and McComb are out for the season.
Starting QB Jay Kastantin (9 starts) was hurt Oct. 31 and Eddie George said he will probably miss the rest of the year; Austin Novosad has started the last two games.
Bowling Green was also without RB Austyn Dendy and WR Winn Sharp in the 19-0 loss at Toledo on Nov. 20.
K.C. Keeler moved Jaxon Smolik back in as the starter vs Rice (27-31 loss) with Ajani Sheppard struggling and nursing an ankle injury.
Coach Jason Eck benched Toa Fa'avae for Luke Moga, who won his first career start 24-17 at Wyoming (234 yards passing, 1 TD, plus a rushing TD).
QB Tyler Hughes has a small fracture in his right forearm from the 41-35 win at UNLV; backup Landon Sims has started the last two (1-1), and no return has been announced.
Landon Varnes has run the offense the last three games (KSU 3-0) after Rickie Collins was benched and then hurt; KSU was 2-6 before, and Collins was questionable on the C-USA report on Nov. 21.
Coach Blake Anderson replaced Landry Lyddy (two straight wins) with dual-threat John White on Nov. 5; Southern Miss is 0-3 in White's starts.
Butch Jones was fired on Nov. 17; associate head coach Jalen Ortiz is interim for the last two games, and the first one was a 48-3 loss at Louisiana Tech.
QB Braden Atkinson (right hand, hurt vs Texas State) is out at Fresno State, his third straight missed game; Maalik Murphy starts again (OSU 1-1 in his starts).

401856765.summary: Tennessee is missing WR Mike Matthews for the year and RB DeSean Bishop is day to day, covering some of the gap; Vanderbilt QB Jared Curtis is expected to play.

reasons.text: WR Mike Matthews (knee) is out for the season.
RB DeSean Bishop (leg, left the LSU game) 'looked good' Monday, but Heupel will decide later in the week.
Lea: QB Jared Curtis is banged up but expected to play; OL Clinton Azubuike and Lyndon Cooper are questionable.

401858540.summary: Ohio State is 1-3 with Luke Fahey since QB Julian Sayin's Oct. 17 elbow injury and Sayin is not expected back for Michigan, covering a good part of the gap; Michigan's QB is also banged up.

reasons.text: Sayin (right elbow surgery) has missed four games and is not expected to play Michigan; Fahey starts.
Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with Fahey at QB, its 4th loss.
Michigan QB Bryce Underwood has a lower-body injury but Whittingham says he will start barring a setback (points our way).

swings.Ohio State: Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with QB Julian Sayin still out and not expected back for Michigan (Athlon); the market marked the Buckeyes down more than our ratings.

401856873.summary: Nothing found explains it: no Arizona or Arizona State injury news turned up, and Arizona's OT win at Kansas State points toward our side.

reasons.text: Arizona beat Kansas State 35-28 in OT on Nov. 21; Noah Fifita threw for 323 yards and 2 TDs.
Arizona State lost 30-27 in OT to Oklahoma State on Nov. 21 after leading by 17 at halftime; QB Jake Fette threw the OT interception.

401856759.summary: FSU is on an interim coach (Norvell fired after Clemson) and badly depleted at RB after a 28-10 home loss to NC State, which explains part of the market's lean to Florida.

reasons.text: FSU lost 28-10 at home to NC State on Nov. 21 with its top four RBs out; Ashton Daniels threw 2 INTs.
Interim coach Rick Stockstill keeps Daniels (FBS-high 14 INTs) as starter; Norvell was fired after the Oct. 31 loss to Clemson.

401858543.summary: UCLA QB Ty Dieffenbach (minor hip) is not ruled out but unlikely to be full go vs USC; the market had USC -10.5 even before the injury, so most of the gap is an older disagreement about UCLA.

reasons.text: Chesney Nov. 23: Dieffenbach's hip is 'a little bit better than we thought' but he is 'nowhere near in the clear'; Madden Iamaleava is next.
Nico Iamaleava is out for the season (torn ACL vs Oregon on Oct. 10).
DraftKings listed USC -10.5 on Nov. 16, before the injury; the SP+ projection is UCLA by 6.8, close to our line.

swings.UCLA: QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT at Michigan on Nov. 21 (minor hip, not ruled out for USC per Chesney Nov. 23, ESPN); our ratings don't see it, the market does.
swings.USC: Mostly the other side of UCLA's QB injury: Ty Dieffenbach was carted off Nov. 21 at Michigan and is uncertain, so the market leans USC (ESPN).

reasons.text: DeBoer said Nov. 23 QB Keelon Russell (ankle) is in a 'good spot' and expected to practice fully after sitting out Chattanooga.
Auburn beat FCS Samford 59-17 on Nov. 21; Tristan Ti'a threw for 341 yards.

swings.Auburn: No Auburn injury news found; Auburn beat FCS Samford 59-17 on Nov. 21, and Alabama QB Keelon Russell, out vs Chattanooga, is expected back (WBRC, Nov. 23).

401856762.summary: Mississippi State still has no Egg Bowl QB named (AJ Swann in a boot, Billy Puckett the backup) with starter Kamario Taylor out for the year; the line opened and sits at Ole Miss -19.

reasons.text: QB Kamario Taylor is out for the season (announced Oct. 27); fill-in AJ Swann wore a boot and missed the Tennessee Tech win.
Lebby: the Egg Bowl starter 'is still kind of being decided'; Billy Puckett threw for 232 yards in the 34-16 Tennessee Tech win.
Ole Miss gets DL Kam Franklin and Will Echoles back and Golding calls the defense himself; RB Kewan Lacy is out for the year.

returning.text: Held out vs Wofford (hamstring); full practice Monday, expected to play.
Held out vs Wofford; practiced Monday, expected to play.

swings.Mississippi State: QB AJ Swann is hurt and the Egg Bowl starter is still undecided (Lebby, Nov. 21); backup Billy Puckett started the 34-16 win over Tennessee Tech.
swings.Ole Miss: Nothing found: the market moved on Ole Miss without a clear reason (it lost RB Kewan Lacy for the season, which points the other way); its last game was vs FCS Wofford.

401866472.summary: Wind (about 14 mph, gusts near 30) at Akron and SP+ running far above Sagarin explain part of the gap; Buffalo still needs a win plus help for the MAC title game.

reasons.text: Open-Meteo forecast for the Nov. 27 noon kick at Akron: wind about 14 mph with gusts near 30 and light rain, which tends to shrink margins.
Buffalo QB E. Holmes (knee) was shut down for the season weeks ago; Jason Wright starts and the passing game is limited (6-of-13 vs CMU).
Buffalo must win and get help to reach the MAC title game; Akron has not named its QB, though Cibastian Broughton started the last three games.

swings.Buffalo: Buffalo has won six straight (40-21 over Central Michigan on Nov. 18, Messiah Burch 200 rush yds); our ratings rose with the streak more than the market, which still prices QB E. Holmes's season-ending injury (UB Athletics).

401871062.summary: Jacksonville State has already clinched its CUSA title-game spot (at Liberty next week), so this game means less to it; Delaware just won 42-30 behind 5 TD passes. SP+ (-9.4) is far from Sagarin (-0.3).

reasons.text: Jax State clinched a CUSA title-game berth with a 25-20 comeback win over Missouri State on Nov. 21; Liberty is the opponent.
Delaware QB Nick Minicucci threw 5 TDs (31-of-41, 398 yds) in a 42-30 win at New Mexico State; the Blue Hens are 6-5.

swings.Delaware: Delaware won 42-30 at New Mexico State on Nov. 21 with Nick Minicucci throwing 5 TDs; the market moved up on the Blue Hens, while Jax State has a title game next (ESPN, 11/21).

401864549.summary: No injury or QB news justifies the shorter number; NDSU is still alive for the Mountain West title game and needs this win, while SJSU (5-7) plays out its season. Our line leans on SP+.

reasons.text: NDSU (9-2) must beat San José State on Nov. 27 to keep its Mountain West title-game path open, per Heavy.
San José State fell 24-22 to UNLV on Nov. 21 when Luke Weaver's tying 2-point pass fell incomplete; Weaver played the whole game.

401871063.summary: Liberty (10-1) has clinched the CUSA title game and plays Jacksonville State next week, so this finale is low-stakes for it; no injury news. SP+ and our model run far above Sagarin.

reasons.text: Liberty clinched a CUSA title-game spot before Week 12 and hosts Jacksonville State on Dec. 5.
Liberty beat Western Kentucky 45-14 on Nov. 21 for its 10th straight win; QB Deshawn Purdie threw for 344 yds, no injuries reported.
Missouri State QB Henry Belin IV played the whole 25-20 loss at Jacksonville State on Nov. 21 (20-of-29); no injury reported.

401862843.summary: North Texas is down to its fourth QB: Tayven Jackson is out, backup Chris Jimerson Jr. hurt his knee at Tulane and Chaston Ditta isn't ready, so slot receiver James Tyre may start; our ratings were built with Jackson.

reasons.text: Neal Brown ruled Tayven Jackson (upper body) out for the UAB game; he hopes Jackson is back for a title or bowl game.
Chris Jimerson Jr. left the 28-24 loss at Tulane early in the second half with a noncontact knee injury; Brown 'wasn't optimistic' about him.
Brown said Chaston Ditta is 'not going to be ready,' so WR James Tyre (4-of-7, 63 yds at Tulane) could start at QB vs UAB.

401858315.summary: Pitt is 1-5 since QB Mason Heintschel's ACL tear and was routed 42-10 at Louisville; our ratings still carry his early games.

reasons.text: Narduzzi has called Holden Geriner the starter when healthy; Geriner threw 2 INTs in the 42-10 loss at Louisville.
Heintschel's season ended with a torn ACL in the Oct. 2 win at Virginia Tech.

401858316.summary: SMU QB Kevin Jennings hurt his ankle in the 24-3 loss at Notre Dame (no update yet), covering part of the gap; Stanford just won the Big Game to reach 6-5.

reasons.text: Lashlee said QB Kevin Jennings rolled his ankle in the 2nd quarter at Notre Dame on Nov. 21, limiting his mobility.
Stanford won the Big Game 44-28 at Cal on Nov. 21 and is 6-5, bowl-eligible.

401866475.summary: UMass QB Pop Watson missed the Akron game and is unconfirmed for this one, which explains part of the lean to Bowling Green, but BG is also on its backup QB (Kastantin likely out for the year).

reasons.text: Pop Watson (ankle) was hurt vs Toledo and missed the Nov. 18 Akron game; Logan Inagawa started the 34-33 loss. No update for Bowling Green yet.
Bowling Green starter Jay Kastantin has been out since Oct. 31 and will probably miss the rest of the year (Eddie George); Austin Novosad has started two games.
Bowling Green was shut out 19-0 at Toledo on Nov. 20 while also missing RB Austyn Dendy and WR Winn Sharp.

401866474.summary: Central Michigan's starting QB Angel Flores is out for the season (Jadyn Glasser starts) and CMU just lost 40-21 at Buffalo; our ratings still carry some Flores games.

reasons.text: Angel Flores will miss the rest of 2026 after ankle surgery; Jadyn Glasser starts in his place.
Buffalo beat Central Michigan 40-21 on Nov. 18 behind Messiah Burch's 200 rushing yards.

401864550.summary: UTEP fired coach Scotty Walden (interim Kyle Beyer) and QB EJ Colson has been out since mid-November, with Raymond Moore III starting; that covers part of the market's lean to Northern Illinois.

reasons.text: UTEP (1-10) fired Scotty Walden after an 8th straight loss; DC Kyle Beyer is interim coach for the Air Force and Northern Illinois games.
EJ Colson missed the Wyoming and Air Force games; Raymond Moore III started the 52-3 loss at Air Force. Rotowire lists Nov. 28 as an estimated return, unconfirmed.
Northern Illinois QB Taron Dickens threw 3 TDs in the 31-25 loss at North Dakota State on Nov. 21; NIU is 0-11.

401862841.summary: Army lost to East Carolina without three starting offensive linemen, which covers part of the gap; Army needs this win to be bowl eligible.

reasons.text: Army played the 10-6 loss to East Carolina on Nov. 21 without three starting linemen (Brady Small, Kyle Kloska, Henry Appleton) and was held to 180 rushing yards.
Army (5-5) calls Rice a must-win for bowl eligibility; no status update on the injured linemen yet.
Rice beat Temple 31-27 on Nov. 19 using several QBs (Crayton Jr., Ochoa) in the comeback.

401858311.summary: Miami is still without WR Malachi Toney, but CB Ja'Boree Antoine and RG Max Buchanan are back practicing and TE Elija Lofton should play; little here backs the market's shorter number.

reasons.text: Toney (high ankle sprain, surgery) has been out since Nov. 4; Cristobal put him about 1.5 weeks out on Nov. 20.
Cristobal Nov. 23: Antoine and Buchanan are practicing and may play; he expects Lofton and LB Chase Smith back.

returning.text: CB out all season since fall camp; practicing, may play BC.
Starting RG hurt vs Clemson (knee surgery); practicing, may play BC.
TE left the Virginia Tech game; Cristobal expects him to play.

401860928.summary: Nothing found justifies the shorter number: Texas State just beat Washington State 42-14, and Utah State (4-7, no bowl) lost 31-24 at Oregon State; no QB news for either.

reasons.text: Utah State lost 31-24 at Oregon State on Nov. 21, falling to 4-7; McCae Hillstead played QB.
Texas State beat Washington State 42-14 in San Marcos on Nov. 21 with Brad Jackson at QB; it beat Utah State 20-17 on Oct. 24.

401869930.summary: South Alabama QB Bishop Davenport is back and the Jaguars won their last two with him, so part of our rating comes from games without him; App State has no injury news.

reasons.text: Bishop Davenport returned from injury on Nov. 7 and has started since; he went 20-of-28 in the 40-35 win at Southern Miss on Nov. 21.
App State QB Malachi Singleton played the whole 17-16 overtime win over ULM on Nov. 21; no injury news.

returning.text: Back as starting QB since Nov. 7 after missing games with an injury.

401862839.summary: USF has lost three straight with backup Luke Kromenhoek since Van Buren's Oct. 31 injury and parted ways with OC Tim Beck after the 35-14 loss at FAU; that covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: USF lost 35-14 at Florida Atlantic on Nov. 21, its third straight loss; Luke Kromenhoek played the whole game.
USF and offensive coordinator Tim Beck parted ways after 11 games.
Starter Michael Van Buren was hurt vs UAB on Oct. 31; no return news found, and Kromenhoek has started since.

401864547.summary: Hawai'i starting QB Micah Alejado was carted off with a lower-leg injury in the Nov. 21 loss at Nevada and no diagnosis is out yet; our ratings were built with him.

reasons.text: QB Micah Alejado was carted off after a defender was blocked into his knee in the 16-8 loss at Nevada; Timmy Chang expected a diagnosis later.
Hawai'i managed 182 total yards at Nevada, its lowest total in 11 years.

401869959.summary: Cameran Brown is ruled out again, so the QB return that explained the market yesterday is off; Ayden Pereira starts and nothing else found justifies the market's closer number.

reasons.text: Georgia State QB Cameran Brown (undisclosed) is out for the Louisiana game, per 247Sports' Brady Weiler; Ayden Pereira is expected to start again.
With Pereira, Georgia State won 39-23 at App State on Nov. 7 and lost 28-27 at Marshall on Nov. 21 on a missed extra point with 2 seconds left.
Louisiana (8-3) beat Coastal Carolina 38-24 on Nov. 21 and is already bowl eligible.

swings.Georgia State: Georgia State nearly won at Marshall (28-27 on Nov. 21, missed PAT with 2 seconds left) with Ayden Pereira at QB; the market rates that team higher than our ratings do, and Cameran Brown stays out (Rotowire, 11/23).

swings.Marshall: Carlos Del Rio-Wilson made his first start since Oct. 10 in the 28-27 win over Georgia State on Nov. 21 (3 TD passes, 1 rush TD) after earlier QB injuries; our ratings rose, the market less so (WCHS).

401858544.summary: Nothing found justifies the market's shorter number: Colton Joseph is set to keep the QB job after the 42-10 win at Purdue, which favors our side; it is a rivalry game.

reasons.text: Fickell said Nov. 23 Colton Joseph 'has earned the right' after the Purdue win; Ryan Hopkins only cleared concussion protocol late last week.

401856875.summary: Nothing found that justifies Colorado (4-7) as a 2-point favorite: UCF QB Alonza Barnett is back and starting after a five-game absence, which if anything favors our UCF side.

reasons.text: UCF QB Alonza Barnett III missed five games (hamstring) and has played the last four, including the 48-17 win over Iowa State.
Colorado (4-7) lost 35-28 at Cincinnati with QB Isaac Wilson throwing three interceptions; no new Colorado injury news found.

returning.text: Back from a five-game hamstring absence (Sept. 19-Oct. 24); four games since.

401858538.summary: Indiana is banged up (C Bray Lynch 'doesn't look good', G Joe Brunner out for the year) and Cignetti won't name a QB between Grant Wilson and Josh Hoover, which covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: Cignetti won't name a QB: Grant Wilson started vs USC and at Washington, with Josh Hoover (shoulder) relieving him at Washington.
Cignetti: 'the only one that doesn't look good right now is Bray Lynch' (C, lower leg); G Joe Brunner is out for the season.

401860929.summary: San Diego State has clinched the Pac-12 title game at Boise State on Dec. 4, so this is a tune-up; that may explain some of the move to Washington State (opened 1, now 3).

reasons.text: SDSU beat Boise State 22-20 on a last-second field goal on Nov. 21, clinching a Pac-12 title-game rematch at Boise on Dec. 4; Stone Saunders started at QB.
Washington State lost 42-14 at Texas State on Nov. 21, its worst loss of the season, and is 2-9.
Saunders replaced Jayden Denegal as SDSU's starter mid-season; SDSU beat Washington State 26-20 on Oct. 31.

swings.Ohio: Nothing found: the market moved on Ohio without a clear reason; no current Ohio or Toledo QB news turned up.

401858314.summary: Syracuse loses starting QB Steve Angeli (shoulder) for the finale and starts Malachi Nelson, which our ratings don't see; that covers most of our 3.8-pt gap.

reasons.text: Fran Brown ruled QB Steve Angeli out with a right AC joint injury from the Nov. 21 BC loss; Malachi Nelson starts.
Notre Dame is also short-handed: S Luke Talich (season), LBs Viliamu-Asa and Bowen, CB McKinney and WR Greathouse are out at Syracuse.
